title: Beef Bourguignon a la Julia Child in an Instant Pot
description: A super simplified version of Julia Child’s famous recipe with beef, carrots, onions and mushrooms made in the Instant Pot.
ingredients: 3 pounds chuck roast, cut into 1 ½ - 2 inch cubes
3 cups beef broth (or 1 1/2 cups red wine + 1 1/2 cups beef broth)
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees, line a sheet pan with aluminum foil, and spray with a little olive. Then, scatter the beef pieces, add some salt and pepper, and sprinkle with 2 to 2 tablespoon of flour; mix in all around. Place the pan in the oven for 10 minutes to brown somewhat, turning once or twice.

Turn Instant Pot to sauté setting. While it’s heating up cut the bacon into quarter inch pieces. Add the bacon pieces into the pot and cook until done. Remove the bacon pieces with a slotted spoon and lay on a paper towel lined plate.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery into the pot and sauté for about 5 minutes.
Pour the broth/wine into the pot and scrape bottom of pot so that nothing is sticking.
Add the bacon and beef back into the pot. Add in the garlic, tomato paste, bay leaf, thyme and parsley.
Cover Instant Pot and secure the lid. Set the manual/pressure cook button to 30 minutes. When time is up use a quick release by moving the valve to venting. Remove the lid.
Take the beef cubes out and strain the liquid, leaving the chopped stuff out (for picking on or otherwise saving).

Add the mushrooms, carrot chunks, and pearl onions into the pot. Cover pot, secure the lid, and set the manual/pressure cook button to 5 minutes. When time is up let the pot sit for at least 10 minutes or a full natural pressure release. Remove the lid.

In a small bowl stir together the melted butter and the flour until smooth. Turn Instant Pot to sauté setting. Stir the flour mixture, along with ½ cup wine, into the pot and let it thicken for about 5 minutes. Season to taste.
